prompt: `popcount64` runs with `rdi = 44` (binary 101100). Each round clears the lowest set bit.
code:
xor eax, eax
.Lloop:
test rdi, rdi
jz .Ldone
lea rcx, [rdi - 1]
and rdi, rcx
inc eax
jmp .Lloop
.Ldone:
ret
explain: `x - 1` flips the lowest set bit and all the zeros below it, so `x & (x - 1)` removes exactly one set bit: 44 -> 40 -> 32 -> 0. The loop runs once per set bit, three times, so `eax` is 3. `lea` does the subtraction without touching the flags `test` just set.
